court: In the High Court of Madras†
case_number: Contempt Petition (MD) No. 3185 of 2025 in W.P.(MD) No. 16911 of 2024
sections_referred: Section 11 of Contempt of Courts Act, 1971
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. A.D. Ganesha Moorthi
prayer: PRAYER: Contempt petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, to issue contempt notice to the contemnor for his willful disobedience in the order passed by this Court in W.P.(MD) No. 16911 of 2024, dated 12-3-2025 and punish him under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

V. Lakshminarayanan, J.:— It is represented by both counsel that the cancellation of mortgage has been executed on 20-3-2026. This is in compliance with the directions issued by this Court on 12-3-2025 in W.P.(MD) No. 16911 of 2024.

2. As the writ petitioner has obtained the remedy only after initiating contempt proceedings, the contemnor/Life Insurance Corporation Housing Finance Limited, West Veli Street, Madurai, shall pay a sum of Rs 10,000 (Rupees Ten Thousand only) as costs to the petitioner within a period of two weeks from today. The costs are commensurate with the expenses incurred by the petitioner in initiating the contempt petition.

3. In view of the above, this contempt petition is closed. In the event of non-payment of costs, it is open to the petitioner to mention the matter for restoration of the contempt petition.
